Construction matrix                                                                                                                                                                                         10 20 Jul 2026 6 / 14

Engineering proposal baseline: For every seam and attachment area, the garment factory must propose stitch class, stitches per inch, seam allowance, seam finish, thread ticket, needle system, reinforcement, and
stabilization as applicable, together with the row-specific requirements below.

  Method notes                                                                                                                                                                                      All measurements in cm unless stated

  Lay the sample flat without stretch. Retained values are first-fit
  targets. Record actual sample values beside the factory's
  confirmed method.

  pattern); N2 Back neck drop (Factory proposes at first pattern); N3
  Across shoulder (Factory proposes at first pattern); N4 Half bicep

  assigned.

  patterns. Visual constants do not define garment measurements.
